<!-- pr-reviewer: bf8069b11bd43d79bfc0c5531b11fe8611e7888d -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- The refusal conditions are untouched: `!m || m.kind !== "plasma"` and the rotary check (`assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps:78-95`) are the same; only the sentence text and the empty-name fallback change (`nm` falls back to `""`, then to "no machine is stated, so none is declared a plasma machine" / "the machine"). A named non-plasma machine keeps the old wording.
- The wording is original and plain; no G-code is touched (diff is one `.cps` refusal string plus one test; `conformance` goldens stay byte-exact).
- The pinning test (`plasma_post_refusals.rs:126-133`) asserts the new text for a null machine and that the double negative never appears; the old-text assertion (`is not declared a plasma machine`, named mill) still holds. No other test or asset references the old fallback.
- The `.cps` exemption from the 400-line rule applies; no process files changed.

**Local results (merged with current main, clean merge)**
| check | result |
|---|---|
| `plasma_post_refusals` | 7 passed |
| `plasma_post` | 5 passed |
| `plasma_gate` | 6 passed |
| `conformance` | 6 passed |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app --tests -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**: the #926 refusal goldens do not exist on main yet, as the body says, so nothing to regenerate.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: bf8069b11bd43d79bfc0c5531b11fe8611e7888d -->
**Independent review.** Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good
- With no machine the refusal now reads: "... only a plasma table reads - no machine is stated, so none is declared a plasma machine". A named non-plasma machine keeps "<name> is not declared a plasma machine" (unchanged, still asserted by the existing VMC check). The rotary refusal falls back to "the machine" instead of an empty subject.
- Only the refusal text changed (`assets/posts/tormach-plasma.cps` machineOk); no PROGRAM line or golden is touched. The new assertion covers both the new wording and the absence of the old one.

Local results (trial-merged with main a6bd69d8, clean)
- `plasma_post_refusals`: 7 passed; `plasma_post`: 5 passed; `conformance`: 6 passed (goldens byte-exact).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --tests -- -D warnings`: clean.

Notes (non-blocking)
- Open PR #1002 (recorded per-post suites) pins the OLD wording ("no machine is not declared a plasma machine") in nine recorded refusal streams. Whichever of #1002 / #1049 merges second must update those recorded refusals to the new sentence (#1002 regenerates its goldens, or #1049 rebases onto it and updates them); the merge-ready label on #1002 will go stale if #1049 lands first.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
